title: Landsat 8/9
thumbCredit: NASA Earth Observatory
description: Process Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 granule archives (.tar/.zip) into Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF disaster-response products with reprojection and activation-event metadata tags. The widest product range of any algorithm in the catalog. You supply the granule yourself, so there is no download step.

products.label: Water extent
products.note: One COG per we_nstd threshold value.

inputs.name: file_path_of_raw_data
inputs.label: Raw data file
inputs.doc: A Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 granule archive (.tar or .zip).

inputs.name: activation_event
inputs.label: Activation event
inputs.doc: Activation event, e.g. 202511_Flood_TX.

inputs.name: products
inputs.label: Products
inputs.doc: Space-separated list (true pan nat colorIR ndvi ndwi mndwi evi nbr we) or 'all'.

inputs.name: source_label
inputs.label: Source
inputs.doc: Data origin (required), e.g. USGS, NASA, NOAA.

inputs.name: dst_crs
inputs.label: Target CRS
inputs.doc: native (default, no warp) | EPSG:3857 | EPSG:4326.

inputs.name: merge
inputs.label: Merge by date/product
inputs.doc: Mosaic tiles by date and product.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Cloud mask
inputs.doc: Generate and apply a cloud mask.

inputs.name: process_date
inputs.label: Process date (optional)
inputs.doc: Only process this date, YYYYMMDD; blank for all dates.

inputs.name: process_tile
inputs.label: Process tile (optional)
inputs.doc: Only process this WRS-2 path/row, e.g. 171035.

inputs.name: we_nstd
inputs.label: Water-extent std devs
inputs.doc: Space-separated std-dev thresholds; only used when products includes 'we'.

inputs.name: compression_level
inputs.label: COG compression level
inputs.doc: ZSTD level 1-22.

inputs.name: nodata
inputs.label: No-data value (optional)
inputs.doc: Override the auto-detected no-data value.

title: Sentinel-2
thumbCredit: NASA Earth Observatory / Copernicus
description: Download Sentinel-2 L2A/L1C scenes from the Copernicus Data Space by MGRS tile and date, then process into Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF disaster-response products. Fully self-serve: it fetches its own imagery, so you only need a tile and a date. Copernicus credentials are read from MAAP secrets at run time and are never job inputs.

products.label: Shortwave infrared
products.note: Cuts through smoke — the workhorse band for active fire.

products.label: Water extent
products.note: One COG per we_nstd threshold value.

inputs.name: tile
inputs.label: MGRS tile(s)
inputs.doc: Sentinel-2 MGRS tile ID(s), e.g. T17RLN (space-separated for several).

inputs.name: activation_event
inputs.label: Activation event
inputs.doc: Activation event, e.g. 202511_Flood_TX.

inputs.name: download_date
inputs.label: Download date (optional)
inputs.doc: One YYYYMMDD, or a start end pair. Blank = the recent-scenes default (~past 10 days).

inputs.name: level
inputs.label: Processing level
inputs.doc: 2 = L2A (surface reflectance), 1 = L1C (top-of-atmosphere).

inputs.name: products
inputs.label: Products
inputs.doc: Space-separated list (true nat swir colorIR ndvi ndwi mndwi nbr we) or 'all'.

inputs.name: we_nstd
inputs.label: Water-extent std devs
inputs.doc: NIR std-dev thresholds; only used when products includes 'we'.

inputs.name: merge
inputs.label: Merge by date/product
inputs.doc: Mosaic scenes by date and product.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Cloud mask
inputs.doc: Generate and apply a cloud mask (L2A only).

title: Satellogic
thumbCredit: NASA Earth Observatory
description: Process very-high-resolution Satellogic optical scenes from the CSDA vendor bucket into COG disaster products. Sub-metre detail makes this the choice for structure-level damage assessment. You select a scene by date — the AOI is whatever the vendor tasked.

inputs.name: date
inputs.label: Target date
inputs.doc: Target acquisition date 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (comma-separated for multi-date). Discover valid dates with the list-dates algorithm.

inputs.name: product
inputs.label: Product
inputs.doc: One of truecolor, colorir, ndvi, ndwi, evi.

inputs.name: level
inputs.label: Processing level
inputs.doc: L1D or L1B.

inputs.name: visualize
inputs.label: Visualize
inputs.doc: Apply gamma stretch (RGB composites only).

inputs.name: gamma
inputs.label: Gamma
inputs.doc: Gamma value when visualize is on.

inputs.name: filter_size
inputs.label: Lee filter window size
inputs.doc: Lee filter window in pixels; must be 3, 5 or 7 (indices only).

inputs.name: activation_event
inputs.label: Activation event
inputs.doc: Activation event, e.g. 202511_Flood_TX.

title: Umbra SAR
thumbCredit: NASA / JPL-Caltech
description: Radiometrically calibrate Umbra SAR scenes into dB backscatter COGs with an always-on NaN-aware Lee speckle filter. SAR sees through cloud and at night, which is what makes it the first useful imagery during a hurricane or a night-time earthquake.

products.label: Sigma-naught (σ⁰)
products.note: The default calibration — normalized to ground area.

title: Capella SAR
thumbCredit: NASA / JPL-Caltech
description: Process Capella SAR scenes into sigma-naught COGs with a Lee speckle filter. Cloud- and night-independent, like Umbra. Single-product by design — the product selector was removed upstream, so sigma-naught is always what you get.

inputs.name: date
inputs.label: Target date
inputs.doc: Target acquisition date, YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. Closest matching scene is selected. Discover valid dates with the list-dates algorithm.

inputs.name: filter_size
inputs.label: Lee filter window size
inputs.doc: Lee speckle-filter window in pixels; must be 3, 5 or 7.

inputs.name: activation_event
inputs.label: Activation event
inputs.doc: Activation event, e.g. 202511_Flood_TX.

inputs.name: source_label
inputs.label: Source
inputs.doc: Data origin, e.g. Capella Space, CSDA.

title: Black Marble (Suomi-NPP)
thumbCredit: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA Black Marble
description: BRDF-corrected VIIRS nighttime lights, sharpened with Landsat and OSM roads, over a bounding box and date. The standard product for mapping power outages after an earthquake or hurricane — where the lights went out is where the damage is. Its 2012-01-19 start date is enforced upstream.

products.label: HD nighttime lights
products.note: BRDF-corrected VNP46A2, sharpened to Landsat + OSM.

products.label: HD nighttime lights (colored)
products.note: Companion colored raster — the blue/yellow outage rendering.

inputs.name: bbox
inputs.label: Bounding box
inputs.doc: WGS84 'min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat'. Latitude span must be at least 0.05°.

inputs.name: activation_event
inputs.label: Activation event
inputs.doc: Activation event, e.g. 202511_Flood_TX.

inputs.name: date
inputs.label: Date
inputs.doc: Acquisition date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or after 2012-01-19.

inputs.name: config
inputs.label: Config profile
inputs.doc: Processing profile, e.g. fast.

inputs.name: osm_source
inputs.label: OSM source
inputs.doc: Where road vectors come from.

inputs.name: wgs84
inputs.label: Also export WGS84
inputs.doc: Emit a secondary WGS84 export.

inputs.name: earthdata_secret_name
inputs.label: Earthdata secret name
inputs.doc: MAAP secret holding the Earthdata token — handled for you.

title: Black Marble (NOAA-20)
thumbCredit: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA Black Marble
description: The NOAA-20 (JPSS-1) counterpart to Black Marble, using VJ146A2. Registered as a separate algorithm rather than a toggle because the two platforms have different coverage windows and write to different output folders. Pair it with Suomi-NPP for a second nightly overpass. Its 2018-01-19 start date is enforced upstream.

title: ICEYE SAR
thumbCredit: NASA / JPL-Caltech
description: PROTOTYPE — not yet a registered DPS algorithm. Calibration code exists (retrieve_iceye_resources, sigmaCalib, lee_filter) and the CSDA vendor bucket is wired, but there is no dps/iceye/algorithm_config.yaml and the package is excluded from packaging. Exercised only through a testing notebook. Listed here because activations do request ICEYE backscatter; treat it as a request for manual processing.

products.label: Sigma-naught (σ⁰)
products.note: Prototype — produced via notebook, not DPS.

inputs.label: Target date
inputs.doc: Target acquisition date. Prototype: no DPS job exists, this is processed by hand.

title: OPERA
thumbCredit: NASA Disasters Portal data gallery — OPERA RTC RGB Mosaic
description: NASA JPL's OPERA analysis-ready products: surface displacement (DISP-S1), surface disturbance (DIST-S1, DIST-ALERT), dynamic surface water extent (DSWx) and terrain-corrected backscatter (RTC). Most are derived from Sentinel-1 C-band SAR; DSWx and DIST-ALERT also use Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS) optical observations. No algorithm in this catalog produces these layers yet: they are made outside it and published on the Disasters Portal, so a request records the need but creates no DPS job.

title: UAVSAR
thumbCredit: NASA Disasters Portal data gallery — UAVSAR Polarimetric False Color Imagery
description: NASA JPL's Uninhabited Aerial Vehicle Synthetic Aperture Radar: an airborne L-band, fully polarimetric SAR flown on a Gulfstream III. Products include polarimetric false color, flood classifications (quicklook and U-Net) and repeat-pass surface displacement. No algorithm in this catalog produces these layers yet: they are made outside it and published on the Disasters Portal, so a request records the need but creates no DPS job.

title: AVIRIS-3
resolution: sub-meter to 13 m (airborne; varies with altitude)
thumbCredit: NASA Disasters Portal data gallery — AVIRIS-3 Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
description: NASA JPL's Airborne Visible/Infrared Imaging Spectrometer 3rd-Generation: airborne imaging spectroscopy across 284 wavelengths, visible to shortwave infrared. Products map char and ash, burn severity (dNBR), spectral differences (PCA) and quicklook false color. No algorithm in this catalog produces these layers yet: they are made outside it and published on the Disasters Portal, so a request records the need but creates no DPS job.
